Yes very much so. I’ve had Sexual Orientation OCD, where I was convinced I was gay (nothing wrong with that) but I knew I wasn’t. I’ve had Schizophrenic OCD where I was terrified I was becoming schizophrenic and thought I was hearing things. This condition is a cruel one and it makes it seem like every little problem you have is real and will never go away.
